Steam Next Fest Update – Monday Syndrome

We Are Joining Steam Next Fest! (Feb 24 - Mar 3)

[previewyoutube=zDlk_iU3tls;full][/previewyoutube]


You wake up. It’s Monday. Again.

Welcome to the endless corporate nightmare of Monday Syndrome, where every day is a twisted cycle of office politics, demonic coworkers, and absurdly destructive office supplies!

We are thrilled to announce that Monday Syndrome developed by hyesmo will be featured in Steam Next Fest from February 24 to March 3! 🎉 This is your chance to experience the chaos firsthand with our free demo, available for a limited time!

💼 What Awaits You in the Demo?

🔥 Survive the office from hell – Battle demonic coworkers, power-hungry bosses, and eldritch HR policies.
🖇 Absurd weapons & upgrades – Turn staplers into nail guns, unleash coffee-powered explosions, and dominate the meeting room!
🏢 Ever-changing office floors – Navigate procedurally generated office layouts and adapt to unpredictable challenges.
👹 Face the ultimate corporate boss – Fight your way up the ranks to demand a raise from Lucifer himself!

This isn’t just another Monday—it’s your chance to break free!

🎮 Play the FREE demo now and join the madness!
